synthesis:draft.headline: At 07:00 UTC / 17:00 AEST on 2026-08-06 the POE50 forecast provably public as-of 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z for TAS1 was 1275.0 MW (evidence ev0562).
summary: The run provably public by 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z contained POE50 = 1275.0 MW for target_end_utc 2026-08-06T07:00:00Z (target_end_local 2026-08-06 17:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) (evidence ev0562).

Other POE50 values in that same provably-public run as-of the cutoff were: POE50 = 1335.0 MW for target_end_utc 2026-08-06T07:30:00Z (target_end_local 2026-08-06 17:30 AEST (UTC+1000)) (evidence ev0565); POE50 = 1386.0 MW for target_end_utc 2026-08-06T08:00:00Z (target_end_local 2026-08-06 18:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) (evidence ev0568); POE50 = 1417.0 MW for target_end_utc 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z (target_end_local 2026-08-06 19:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) (evidence ev0574).

For the event peak interval (target_end_utc 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z; target_end_local 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) the POE50 in the run provably public by the cutoff was 1084.0 MW (evidence ev0538).

Measured operational demand provably public by 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z was available only up to interval_end_utc 2026-08-05T18:00:00Z (interval_end_local 2026-08-06 04:00 AEST (UTC+1000)); the maximum in that available series was 1053.0 MW (evidence ev0582).
